title: Core pushout and over-base gluing assertions for dual-number tangent vectors.
statement: theorem tangentVectors_core (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) : let K := X.residueField x let D := Spec (.of (DualNumber K)) let E := Spec (.of (TrivSqZeroExt K (Fin 2 → K))) let b := X.fromSpecResidueField x let c : Spec K ⟶ D := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom K K K).toRingHom) let q : D ⟶ Spec K := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.inlHom K K)) let r : E ⟶ Spec K := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.inlHom K (Fin 2 → K))) let j : Fin 2 → (D ⟶ E) := fun i => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.map (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin 2 → K) →ₗ[K] K)).toRingHom) let T := {θ : D ⟶ X // c ≫ θ = b ∧ θ ≫ p = q ≫ b ≫ p} IsPushout c c (j 0) (j 1) ∧ (∀ θ₁ θ₂ : T, ∃! Θ : E ⟶ X, j 0 ≫ Θ = θ₁.val ∧ j 1 ≫ Θ = θ₂.val) ∧ (∀ θ₁ θ₂ : T, ∀ Θ : E ⟶ X, j 0 ≫ Θ = θ₁.val → j 1 ≫ Θ = θ₂.val → Θ ≫ p = r ≫ b ≫ p)
